newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fair Isaac raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fair Isaac raised to buy.

text.p: Jefferies & Co Inc analyst Vince Turzo raised his rating on shares of Fair Isaac & Company Inc to buy from accumulate.
-- In a statement, Turzo said a recent 12 percent decline in the company's stock price presents a buying opportunity.
-- said the company holds a dominant position in the credit market and has an expanding presence in the insurance and direct marketing arenas.
-- said company should be able to achieve earnings growth of 25 percent per year over the next three to five years.
-- The company is a leading developer of statistical tools, called scoring algorithms, used to evaluate credit applicants.
-- Fair Isaac shares were up 5/8 at 42-7/8 by midday Friday.
